value.body: A pharma production technician runs and records the steps that turn raw materials into medicines — mixing, granulating, compressing, filling and packing. Pharmaceutical manufacturing plants hire them, typically in shift work. Every step follows written procedures and good manufacturing practice (GMP) rules.

items.label: Rules followed
items.value: Good manufacturing practice (Schedule M) and written SOPs

value.title: How you get in
value.body: Freshers usually join through walk-in or campus drives at pharma plants as a trainee or production operator, with GMP and machine training on the job. Plants are often in industrial clusters, so relocation may be needed.

value.title: At a glance
items: Common next roles: senior operator, shift supervisor, or moves to packing or quality roles.
Shift work, including nights, is common in plants.
A B.Pharm through lateral entry can open officer-level roles later.
